# CARD-<tipo>-### — Card title

> This is the English translation of [card.md](card.md). The Spanish version is canonical: if they differ, the Spanish version prevails (D-29).

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `hacienda` / `migracion` / `correo` / `mensajeria` / `verdad` / `reto` |
| Modes | `familiar_u18`, `familiar_18`, `party_18`, `party_extreme_18`, `parejas_18` (those that apply) |
| Intensity | 1 / 2 / 3 |
| Visibility | `público` / `propietario` |
| Editorial status | `borrador` / `revisado` / `aprobado` |
| Reviewed by | |

## Text
What the table or the player reads. No private data if it is public.

## Effect
Reference to an effect **defined in the spec** (`EVT-###` or a typed effect). Never free-form logic.

- Valid target:
- Duration (rounds):
- Stackable with effects of the same type: no

## Truth or Dare (those types only)
- Allows passing: **yes**, always
- Penalty for passing (fixed and visible before accepting):
- Safety check: no harm, no mandatory alcohol, no non-consensual contact, no exposure of private data.

## Disclosures
What the public sees and what the affected player sees. If the effect is proportional to cash, the amount is never public.

## Art
Associated asset brief (`templates/asset-brief.md`), if the card has an illustration.
